Shredder API and FEC set size calculations for entry batches.

# Purpose
This header defines the `fd_shredder` interface used to convert an entry batch into Solana-style shreds and FEC sets. It declares the `fd_shredder_t` state object, the memory layout helpers, and the batch life cycle functions [`fd_shredder_init_batch`](<#fd_shredder_init_batch>), [`fd_shredder_next_fec_set`](<#fd_shredder_next_fec_set>), [`fd_shredder_fini_batch`](<#fd_shredder_fini_batch>), and related join and delete functions. The file also contains inline count helpers for data shreds, parity shreds, and FEC sets, with fixed tables and rules for normal, chained, and resigned Merkle shred types. It includes feature-activation slots and constants that control shred versioning, Merkle tree size, parity counts, and signing support through `fd_shredder_sign_fn`.
